itsallsame_documented: Compare a supplier CSV with a Shopify-ready CSV
Files are read in this browser; this page sends no file contents to a server
Up to 2 MB and 1,000 data records
Choose a unique identifier on each side. Keys are case-sensitive. Duplicate, blank or padded identifiers go to review; this prototype never guesses a match
choose column mappings (Purpose / Supplier column / Shopify column)
filters: All, Review, Different, Supplier only, Shopify only, Equal
"Equal" means only the selected raw fields agree. "Different" can include harmless formatting differences, such as 10.00 vs 10
A one-supplier pilot starts at US$19 (paid service, advertised)
globalland_tested_synthetic: explicit key column per side, keys trimmed (padding not flagged as review)
explicit field pairs with kind price/stock/option/value
explicit per-field value map (e.g. M -> Medium) applied only when confirmed
blank price/stock cells flagged ambiguous_blank, not compared
CSV differences export (row, other_row, key, field, values)
raw string comparison: 10.00 vs 10 is also a difference

usd19_assessment: No supported advantage. The US$19 figure originated from the thread OP as a proposed price; the one participant who called it reasonable later declined a US$19 offer for this exact job; another said Excel/Power Query makes it unnecessary; a free equivalent with the same core safeguards is live. Our marginal differences (value maps, CSV export, >1000 rows) are synthetic-tested only and not requested as paid features.
verdict_detail: Stop Gumroad package preparation for supplier-shopify-diff. Keep the prototype free; any future publication remains subject to the existing parked deploy blocker and exact-digest review. Do not reopen paid packaging unless a classified REQUEST names value mapping, CSV export or >1000-row files as something they would pay for.
